render_note: Fig. 11 is a 554 x 369 pixel RGB image over 405 x 270 points (98.5 dpi); rendered at 98 dpi, close to one render pixel per image pixel. Picks placed from edge traces (first pixel darker than 110 along rows or columns).
period_note: All walls on this plan belong to the Early Harappan period (caption: Structural remains of early Harappan period from Area B); the Mature Harappan structures of Karanpura are shown only in a photograph (IAR 2013-14 Plate 38).

north.evidence: IAR 2013-14 Figs. 11-12 (PDF p. 95, printed p. 90), Fig. 11 upper left: an eight-point compass rose on a vertical stem with an arrowhead at its upper end; no letter N and no true or magnetic wording. The arrowhead end is taken as north.
north.survey_year_evidence: Plan title: Structural Remains of Early Harappan Period (Area B) Karanpura, district Hanumangarh, Rajasthan (2012-13).

scale.evidence: Excavation grid lines labelled E180, E190 and E200 along the top edge at x about 184, 364 and 544, assumed 10 m apart; the graphic scale bar at the top (ticks every 18.5 px) is too blurred to read its labels but agrees with 18 px per metre.
